name: CSV Discovery
description: Import items from CSV files in a local directory. Reads all unprocessed CSVs, maps columns to pipeline item format. Designed for external tools (LinkedIn exports, cron scripts, community lists) that drop CSV files into a shared folder.

options.name: upload_dir
options.label: Upload CSV/XLSX files
options.description: Upload files directly. XLSX files are auto-converted to CSV. Processed alongside source_dir files.

options.name: source_dir
options.label: Source directory (optional)
options.description: Absolute path to folder containing CSV files. Leave empty if using upload only.

options.name: file_pattern
options.label: File pattern
options.description: Glob pattern for CSV filenames to process

options.name: column_map
options.label: Column mapping
options.description: Maps pipeline field names to CSV column headers

options.name: source_label
options.label: Source label
options.description: Value for the 'source' field on output items

options.name: skip_processed
options.label: Skip already-processed files
options.description: Track processed files and skip them on re-runs

options.name: exclude_keywords
options.label: Exclude keywords
options.description: Filter out items whose title contains these terms (case-insensitive)

options.name: entity_production
options.label: Produce entities from results
options.description: When enabled, each approved item becomes its own entity for downstream steps (each gets scraped/analyzed independently).

options.name: entity_name_template
options.label: Entity name template
options.description: How to name produced entities. Use {field} placeholders: {title}, {company}, {source}, {url}. Only used when entity_production is enabled.
